Method of Attack: Web-based card skimming script that steals payment information from customers by injecting malicious JavaScript into the Poker Tracker website and software.
Data exfiltration by verifying, serializing, and encrypting payment data with a weak password ('love1234') and sending it to the attacker's server.
Attack Vector: Injection of Magecart skimmer script into the PokerTracker.com website running outdated Drupal CMS.
Loading of malicious JavaScript from ajaxclick[.]com domain by the Poker Tracker software via its subdomain pt4.pokertracker.com.
Indicators of Compromise: Hardcoded references to PokerTracker.com in the skimmer code
Use of weak encryption password 'love1234' in the skimmer script
